en.editorNote: Send to the friend who pushes themselves too hard and feels they 'can't fall apart' — give them permission to solve nothing today
variations: Short: First eat, first sleep, first stay alive — the days will slowly catch the rest for you.
More: Not every day needs to mean something. Some days the only task is getting through it — and that's already impressive.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 就算全世界都叫你別做夢，你也可以偷偷替自己留一盞燈。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合鼓勵正在猶豫要不要追夢的朋友，或放在勵志貼文裡
variations: 別人可以熄掉你的火，但點燈的手一直在你自己身上。
夢想不必大聲宣布，先在心裡替它留個位子就好。

en.content: Even if the whole world tells you to stop dreaming, you're allowed to keep one little light on for yourself.
en.editorNote: Great for cheering on a friend who's hesitating about chasing a dream
variations: People can blow out your fire, but the hand that relights it is always your own.
You don't have to announce your dream out loud—just save it a seat in your heart.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 我不需要你變成更好的人，我只是想成為你回家路上會想起的那個人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合含蓄的告白，或情侶之間表達不求回報的喜歡
variations: 你不用為我努力變好，我只想待在你偶爾會想念的角落。
比起改變你，我更想成為你疲憊時第一個想起的名字。

en.content: I don't need you to become a better person—I just want to be the one you think of on your way home.
en.editorNote: Works for a low-key confession or telling someone you love them without conditions
variations: You don't have to improve for me; I just want to be the corner of your day you quietly miss.
Instead of changing you, I'd rather be the first name you think of when you're worn out.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 日子過不下去的時候，先把今天過完就好，明天的份，明天再擔心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合安慰正在低潮的人，也可放在深夜療癒系限動
variations: 撐不住的時候，只要求自己活過這一天，其他的先放一邊。
別急著扛起整個未來，先把眼前這一頓飯好好吃完。

en.content: When life feels unbearable, just get through today—tomorrow's worries can wait until tomorrow.
en.editorNote: Good for comforting someone in a rough patch, or a late-night cozy post
variations: When you can't hold on, just ask yourself to make it through this one day and set the rest aside.
Don't rush to carry the whole future—just finish the meal in front of you first.

items.sourceNote: KORB韓劇告白台詞整理，2025愛情劇心動場景，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
「不知道從什麼時候開始，
我看到的每一個東西，
都會想到你。

吃飯的時候想，
這個你應該會喜歡；
下雨的時候想，
你今天有沒有帶傘；
連發呆的時候想的，
也是你。

所以我想問——
是因為喜歡你，才什麼都想到你，
還是因為什麼都想到你，
我才發現我喜歡你？」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個你已經藏不住的人，或分享在深夜有點想某個人的貼文
variations: 更短的版本：我本來想撐到最後都保持理智的，結果我先瘋了——因為我滿腦子都是你。
反過來寫：我不是突然喜歡你的，是我突然發現，原來已經喜歡你很久了。

en.content:
"I don't know when it started,
but everything I see
makes me think of you.

When I eat, I think—
you'd probably like this.
When it rains, I think—
did you bring an umbrella today.
Even when I'm just staring into space,
I'm thinking of you.

So let me ask you this:
am I thinking of you because I like you,
or did I only realize I like you
because I can't stop thinking of you?"
en.editorNote: For someone you can no longer hide it from — or a late-night post when a certain person is on your mind
variations: Shorter: I tried to stay sane until the very end, but I lost that fight first — because you're all I think about.
Flip it: I didn't suddenly start liking you. I just suddenly realized I'd been liking you for a very long time.

items.sourceNote: POPBEE低潮時的10句韓劇台詞，人生勵志向，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
有些人在泥潭裡，
看到過得比自己好的人，
不會想著「我也要爬到那裡去」，
而是想著「你也一起下來吧」。

你不欠任何人一起沉下去的義務。

他們想把你拉進泥潭，
是因為他們爬不出來——
那是他們的難題，
不是你要背的行李。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被身邊的人一直往下拖、快要動搖的朋友——提醒他別人的泥潭不是他的責任
variations: 換個角度：不是每個叫你留下的人，都是為你好；有些人只是不想一個人待在原地。
更硬的版本：你要往上走，不用先徵得那些想拉你下去的人同意。

en.content:
Some people, stuck in the mud,
see someone doing better than them
and don't think "I want to climb up there too."
They think "come down here with me."

You don't owe anyone the favor of sinking too.

They want to pull you into the mud
because they can't climb out themselves —
that's their problem to solve,
not luggage you have to carry.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend being dragged down by the people around them and starting to waver — a reminder that someone else's mud isn't their responsibility
variations: Another angle: not everyone who tells you to stay wants what's best for you — some just don't want to sit still alone.
Blunter: you don't need permission from the people trying to pull you down before you climb up.

items.sourceNote: Beauty321韓劇心動表白台詞20句，陪伴主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
「不管是在哪裡，
不管是什麼時候，
只要我一轉頭，
希望站在我旁邊的人，
都是你。

不是最耀眼的那個場合，
不是最好的那個版本的我——
就算是最普通的一天，
最狼狽的樣子，
我想要旁邊的人，
還是你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合認真交往一段時間後想說的話，或求婚、紀念日場合的告白靈感
variations: 延伸：我不是想要一個完美的未來，我是想要一個有你的未來，就算它不完美。
短版：以後每一次我回頭，我都想看到你還在。

en.content:
"Wherever it is,
whenever it is,
the moment I turn my head,
I want the person standing beside me
to be you.

Not in the most dazzling setting.
Not the best version of me.
Even on the most ordinary day,
even at my most disheveled,
the person I want beside me
is still you."
en.editorNote: For when you're ready to say something real after dating a while — or as inspiration for a proposal or anniversary confession
variations: Extended: I don't want a perfect future. I want a future with you in it, even if it isn't perfect.
Short: every time I turn around from now on, I want to see that you're still there.

items.sourceNote: POPBEE淚之女王婚姻與愛情金句，關係主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
沒有一種選擇，
是天生就正確的。

結婚、不結婚、離婚、重來，
它們都只是「選項」，
沒有一個附上正確答案。

我們該做的，
不是拼命去選那個對的，
而是選了之後，
用力把它活成對的。

答案不是選出來的，
是過出來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在為人生重大決定糾結、怕選錯的朋友——或分享在關於選擇的貼文
variations: 換句話說：你不會因為選對了才幸福，你會因為認真經營，讓當初的選擇變成對的。
更短：重點從來不是哪條路對，而是你有沒有把走的那條走成對的。

en.content:
No choice comes
labeled correct from the start.

Married, single, divorced, starting over —
they're all just options,
none of them stamped with the right answer.

What we're supposed to do
isn't scramble to pick the correct one.
It's pick, and then
work hard to make it the right one.

The answer isn't chosen.
It's lived into.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend agonizing over a big life decision and terrified of choosing wrong — or a post about making choices
variations: In other words: you don't get happy because you chose right. You make the choice right by tending to it.
Shorter: it was never about which road is correct. It's whether you turn the one you took into the right one.

items.sourceNote: KORB韓劇告白台詞整理，等待與暗戀主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
「聽說啊，
愛得比較多的那個人，
本來就要負責等。

沒關係，
我剛好很擅長等。

我可以等你想清楚，
等你準備好，
等你哪天回頭，
發現我一直都在。

我不是沒有時間，
我只是決定，
把時間都花在你身上。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合默默喜歡一個人、還不打算催對方的心情——或深夜暗戀向的貼文
variations: 延伸：我不催你，不是因為我不急，是因為我不想讓你覺得，喜歡我是一種壓力。
反轉的殘酷版：可是等待也有期限，我願意等，不代表我會等到把自己等丟。

en.content:
"They say
the one who loves more
is the one who's supposed to wait.

That's fine.
As it happens, I'm good at waiting.

I can wait for you to figure it out,
wait for you to be ready,
wait for the day you turn around
and find I've been here the whole time.

It's not that I have nothing but time.
I just decided
to spend all of mine on you."
en.editorNote: For quietly liking someone without rushing them — or a late-night post about an unspoken crush
variations: Extended: I don't rush you not because I'm not anxious, but because I don't want liking me to feel like pressure.
The colder flip side: but waiting has a deadline too. I'm willing to wait — that doesn't mean I'll wait until I lose myself.

items.sourceNote: QuickQuery韓劇療癒金句整理，傷口與自我修復主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你手腕上那道疤，
是國中翻牆留下的。

當時縫了五針，
你回家跟你媽說沒事，
說自己走路跌倒。

它到現在還在，
變成一條很淡的白線。

沒有一道傷
會因為你假裝沒看見，
就自己好起來。

它只是換一種方式
留在你身上，

提醒你撐過來了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在硬撐、習慣說「我沒事」的朋友——或分享在關於情緒復原的貼文
variations: 更短：疤不是你輸過的紀錄，是你活下來的紀錄。
延伸：復原沒有時間表，你不用比誰快好，你只要不放棄好起來就夠了。

en.content:
No wound heals
just because you pretend
you're fine.

You think holding back tears is strength,
but all it does
is bury the pain somewhere deeper.

You're not broken.
You're still healing.

Those scars
aren't proof that you're fragile —
they're proof that you made it through.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps toughing it out and always says 'I'm fine' — or share on a post about emotional recovery
variations: Shorter: scars aren't a record of losing. They're a record of surviving.
Extended: healing has no schedule. You don't have to get better faster than anyone. You just have to not give up on getting better.

items.sourceNote: QuickQuery韓劇友情主題觀察，友情不輸愛情，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
韓劇最狡猾的地方是：
你以為主線是愛情，
結果最後戳中你的，
是那段友情。

是那個不用解釋就懂你的人，
是那個你半夜傳「在嗎」、
他真的秒回的人，
是那個看你哭
卻什麼都不問，只是坐在旁邊的人。

愛情會讓你心動，
但那種友情，
會讓你敢繼續活下去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個陪你度過最低潮、卻從來不邀功的朋友——直接讓他知道他有多重要
variations: 延伸：談戀愛的人很多，願意在你最狼狽時留下來的人很少——後者才是真正稀有的。
更短：愛情負責讓生活變甜，友情負責讓你撐過生活。

en.content:
The sneakiest thing about K-dramas:
you think the main plot is the romance,
but what actually wrecks you
in the end is the friendship.

It's the person who gets you without explanation.
It's the one you text 'you up?' at 2am
and who actually replies instantly.
It's the one who watches you cry
and asks nothing — just sits beside you.

Romance makes your heart race.
But that kind of friendship
is what makes you brave enough to keep living.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who got you through your lowest point and never took credit — just let them know how much they matter
variations: Extended: plenty of people will date you. Few will stay when you're at your most wrecked. The second kind is the rare one.
Shorter: romance makes life sweeter. Friendship is what gets you through life.

items.sourceNote: KORB與2026新劇告白台詞觀察，衝動奔赴主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
「你問我是不是喜歡你？

如果我不喜歡你，
我會凌晨三點
開四百公里的車去看你嗎？

我會為了你一句『我有點想你』，
把所有計畫全部推翻嗎？

喜歡一個人，
嘴巴可以裝，
但腳騙不了人。

我人都到你面前了，
這還不夠說明嗎？」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合那種嘴上不承認、但行動已經全部出賣自己的心情——或告白向的限動
variations: 延伸：我不擅長講漂亮的情話，所以我用最笨的方式證明——我出現在你需要我的每一個地方。
反轉：可惜有些人願意為你開四百公里，卻不願意為你改一個習慣——路程從來不是重點。

en.content:
"You're asking if I like you?

If I didn't,
would I drive four hundred kilometers
at three in the morning just to see you?

Would I scrap every plan I had
over one text — 'I kinda miss you'?

Liking someone —
your mouth can fake it,
but your feet can't.

I'm standing right in front of you.
Isn't that answer enough?"
en.editorNote: For when your mouth won't admit it but your actions already gave you away — or a confession-mood story post
variations: Extended: I'm bad at pretty words, so I'll prove it the dumbest way I know — by showing up everywhere you need me.
The flip side: too bad some people will drive four hundred km for you but won't change one habit. The distance was never the point.

items.sourceNote: QuotesCafe韓劇自我價值金句整理，不需被誰認可主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你不需要
每個人都喜歡你。

你花那麼多力氣
去讓一個不在乎你的人點頭，
那些力氣，
本來可以拿去愛
那些早就在乎你的人。

不被某些人接受，
不代表你不夠好，
只代表你們不是同一種人。

你的價值，
從來不需要別人簽名同意。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直想討好某個人、卻越活越委屈的朋友——提醒他停止把力氣花錯地方
variations: 更短：不是每個人都值得你解釋，也不是每個人都需要懂你。
延伸：你不是要贏過討厭你的人，你只是要好到讓自己都佩服自己。

en.content:
You don't need
everyone to like you.

All that energy you spend
trying to make someone who doesn't care
finally nod at you —
that energy could've gone
toward loving the people
who already do.

Not being accepted by certain people
doesn't mean you're not good enough.
It just means you're not the same kind of person.

Your worth
never needed anyone's signature.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend wearing themselves down trying to please someone — remind them to stop spending energy in the wrong place
variations: Shorter: not everyone deserves your explanation, and not everyone needs to understand you.
Extended: you're not trying to beat the people who dislike you. You're just trying to get good enough to impress yourself.

items.sourceNote: POPBEE《淚之女王》經典台詞整理，愛情是共同承受痛苦主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
談戀愛的時候，
大家都以為愛是
甜言蜜語、心跳加速、
每天都想見面。

可是真正的愛，
是那些不甜的部分——

是一起熬過最難看的低潮，
是你想逃的時候他還站在原地，
是把「我先走了」
改成「我陪你到底」。

心動誰都會，
留下來的才算數。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在懷疑「還愛不愛」的朋友，或適合放在感情長跑週年的限動——提醒愛不是只有心動的部分
variations: 更短：會讓你心跳的人很多，願意陪你度過難看時刻的人很少。
延伸：所謂長久，不是天天怦然心動，而是吵完架還是選你、累到不行還是回你家。

en.content:
When you first fall for someone,
you think love is
sweet words, racing hearts,
wanting to see them every single day.

But real love
lives in the parts that aren't sweet —

getting through the ugliest lows together,
them still standing there
when you want to run,
turning "I'm heading out"
into "I'm staying till the end."

Anyone can make your heart race.
Staying is what actually counts.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend questioning whether they still love someone, or pin it on a relationship-anniversary story — a reminder that love isn't only the butterflies
variations: Shorter: plenty of people can make your heart race. Very few will sit with you through the ugly parts.
Extended: lasting love isn't daily butterflies — it's choosing them after the fight, coming home to them when you're wrecked.

items.sourceNote: KORB《歡迎回到三達里》系列愛情金句整理，想念與飢餓的隱喻，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
「我最近搞不清楚一件事：

是因為肚子餓，
所以我一直想到你？

還是因為我一直想到你，
所以連肚子餓的感覺
都變成了你？

吃了東西也沒用，
看了電影也沒用，
這種餓，
只有見到你才會停。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合曖昧期、想告白但講不出口的時刻——可以直接傳給對方，也可以放在心動限動
variations: 延伸：後來我發現，我不是想你，我是連呼吸的空檔都在想你，只是我以為那叫肚子餓。
更土的版本：別人餓了會找食物，我餓了會找你，因為你比任何一餐都讓我滿足。

en.content:
"Lately there's one thing I can't figure out:

Am I thinking about you
because I'm hungry?

Or am I so hungry
because I keep thinking about you
that even the hunger
started to feel like you?

Eating doesn't fix it.
A movie doesn't fix it.
This kind of hungry
only stops when I see you."
en.editorNote: For the in-between stage when you want to confess but can't say it out loud — send it straight to them, or post it as a heart-fluttering story
variations: Extended: turns out I wasn't just thinking of you. I was thinking of you in every gap between breaths — I just called it hunger.
Cheesier version: other people find food when they're hungry. I find you. You fill me up more than any meal ever could.

items.sourceNote: POPBEE低潮時十句韓劇台詞整理，聖誕樹在任何角落都閃耀的比喻，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
一棵聖誕樹，
不管被放在哪裡——

擺在沒人經過的地下室、
塞在角落的小店門口、
還是佈置在最熱鬧的廣場中央——

它都一樣在發光，
一樣讓經過的人
心裡亮一下。

它從來不會因為
沒人看見，
就決定不閃了。

你也是。
沒被看見的時候，
你依然值得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個覺得「沒人注意到我努力」而失落的朋友——你的價值不是靠掌聲決定的
variations: 更短：發不發光是你的事，看不看見是別人的事，別把兩件事搞混。
延伸：不要因為現在站在沒人經過的角落，就把自己的燈關掉——總有一天有人會為了你的光繞路過來。

en.content:
A Christmas tree,
no matter where you put it —

tucked in a basement no one walks through,
crammed by the door of a shop nobody visits,
or set up in the busiest square in town —

it shines just the same.
It still makes the heart
of anyone passing by
flicker for a second.

It never decides
to stop lighting up
just because no one is looking.

Neither should you.
Even unseen,
you're still worth it.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend feeling low because 'no one notices how hard I try' — your worth isn't decided by applause
variations: Shorter: whether you shine is your job. Whether they see it is theirs. Don't confuse the two.
Extended: don't switch off your own light just because you're standing in an empty corner right now. Someone will go out of their way for it.

items.sourceNote: TVBS《今生也請多指教》人生台詞整理，大人都是裝出來的主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為，
長大就會變成一個
什麼都懂的大人。

結果長大之後才發現：

沒有人真的懂。

那些看起來很鎮定的大人，
只是比較會裝而已。

他們也會慌、
也會後悔、
也會半夜睡不著
懷疑自己是不是搞砸了。

所以你不用急著
把自己活成完美的樣子——
大家都是邊裝邊學的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個覺得「別人都好像很有把握、只有我一團亂」的朋友——其實大家都在裝
variations: 更短：所謂大人，就是慌歸慌，還是把事情做完的人。

延伸：別羨慕那些看起來很穩的人，他們只是把崩潰的部分
藏在你看不到的地方。

en.content:
As a kid you assumed
growing up meant becoming
an adult who had it all figured out.

Then you grew up and realized:

nobody actually does.

The adults who look so composed
are just better at faking it.

They panic too.
They have regrets too.
They lie awake at 3 a.m.
wondering if they messed everything up.

So don't rush
to make yourself look perfect —
everyone is just improvising as they go.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who thinks 'everyone else seems so sure and I'm a mess' — everyone is faking it
variations: Shorter: being an adult just means finishing the thing even while you're quietly freaking out.
Extended: don't envy the people who look so steady. They just hide the falling-apart part where you can't see it.

items.sourceNote: 電影神搜《壞媽媽》經典台詞整理，只要活著自然就能活下去主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你現在覺得撐不下去，
我懂。

但你知道嗎——

你不需要一次
把整條路走完。

你只要先起床，
先吃一口飯，
先把今天過完就好。

日子這種東西，
只要你還活著，
它就會自己
一天一天
把你往前帶。

你不用很勇敢，
你只要
別放開自己的手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在低潮、覺得每天都好難的朋友——不用一次好起來，先活過今天就夠了
variations: 更短：不用撐住一輩子，你只要撐住今天，明天再說。
延伸：有些日子的目標就是「活著」，光是這個，你今天已經達成了。

en.content:
You feel like you can't go on
right now. I get it.

But here's the thing —

you don't have to walk
the whole road at once.

Just get out of bed.
Just take one bite of food.
Just get through today.

Days are strange like that:
as long as you're still alive,
they carry you forward
on their own,
one at a time.

You don't have to be brave.
You just have to
not let go of your own hand.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend in a rough patch who finds every day hard — you don't have to be okay all at once, just make it through today
variations: Shorter: you don't have to hold on for a lifetime. Just hold on for today. Tomorrow can wait.
Extended: some days the only goal is 'stay alive.' And just by reading this, you've already hit today's.

items.sourceNote: 《歡迎回到三達里／苦盡柑來遇見你》愛的溫度主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
不是每個人
都能跟最愛的人結婚。

這句話聽起來很殘忍，
但其實它想說的是——

愛的大小，
其實都差不多。

真正不一樣的，
是溫度。

有些愛燒得又快又旺，
照亮一整個夏天，
然後就熄了。

有些愛不燙，
只是溫溫的，
在你手心一放
就是一輩子。

我不要那種會燒完的，
我要那種
可以牽著你走到老的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個陪你走過平淡日常、不轟轟烈烈但一直都在的另一半——溫的才走得遠
variations: 更短：轟轟烈烈的會燒完，溫溫的才牽得到老。
延伸：我不羨慕那種一見鍾情的故事，我只想要一個願意每天都選我的人。

en.content:
Not everyone gets to marry
the person they loved the most.

It sounds cruel,
but here's what it really means —

the size of the love
was never that different.

What was different
was the temperature.

Some love burns fast and bright,
lights up a whole summer,
and then goes out.

Some love isn't scorching.
It's just warm.
Rest it in your palm
and it stays a lifetime.

I don't want the kind
that burns out.
I want the kind
I can hold on to
all the way to old age.
en.editorNote: Send to the partner who's walked through the ordinary days with you — not fireworks, just always there. Warm is what lasts
variations: Shorter: the blazing kind burns out. The warm kind is what you hold to the end.
Extended: I don't envy the love-at-first-sight stories. I just want someone who chooses me again every single day.

items.sourceNote: 《宮廷料理／御膳合味道》肚子餓與想你主題告白台詞，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我最近有個困擾。

到底是因為肚子餓
才一直想到你，

還是因為一直想到你，
才覺得心裡空空的，
像肚子餓。

我認真研究過了。

昨天我吃了兩碗飯、
一份炸雞、
一杯珍奶，
吃到快撐死。

然後我還是想你。

所以你說，
這筆帳
到底該算誰的？
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給剛在曖昧、想講情話又怕太肉麻的對象——用「肚子餓」當包裝，土得剛剛好
variations: 更短：我以為我餓了，吃飽才發現，原來是想你。
回敬版：那你多想我幾次，這樣就不用花錢吃飯了。

en.content:
I've had a problem lately.

I can't figure out —

am I thinking about you
because I'm hungry,

or am I hungry
because thinking about you
leaves this empty feeling
right here in my chest?

So I ran a serious experiment.
Conclusion:

I ate. I'm full.
I'm still thinking about you.

So it's probably
not hunger.

It's you.
en.editorNote: Send to the person you're in the flirty early stage with — a confession dressed up as 'I'm hungry.' Cheesy in exactly the right dose
variations: Shorter: I thought I was hungry. Ate a full meal. Turns out I just missed you.
Comeback version: then think about me more often — saves me money on food.

items.sourceNote: 《未知的首爾》昨天已過明天未到今天仍是未知主題，療癒改編

zh-tw.content:
你為什麼一直那麼焦慮？

因為你的腦袋
同時活在兩個地方——

一個是昨天，
那裡放著你後悔的事，

一個是明天，
那裡塞滿你還沒發生就先怕的事。

可是有件事你忘了：

昨天已經走了，
明天還沒來，

你真正站著的
只有今天。

而今天
還是一張
沒寫完的白紙。

別急著替它
寫壞結局。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是為還沒發生的事先崩潰的朋友——昨天回不去，明天叫不來，你只有今天可以過
variations: 更短：昨天走了，明天沒來，你唯一擁有的就是今天，別浪費在擔心上。
延伸：焦慮就是提前為一件可能不會發生的事付利息，你划得來嗎？

en.content:
Why are you always so anxious?

Because your head
is living in two places at once —

one is yesterday,
where you keep everything
you regret,

the other is tomorrow,
stuffed with things
you're scared of
before they've even happened.

But you forgot one thing:

yesterday already left,
tomorrow hasn't arrived,

and the only place
you're actually standing
is today.

And today
is still a blank page.

Don't rush to write it
a bad ending.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who falls apart over things that haven't happened yet — you can't go back to yesterday, can't summon tomorrow. Today is all you've got
variations: Shorter: yesterday's gone, tomorrow isn't here. Today is the only thing you own — don't spend it worrying.
Extended: anxiety is paying interest on a debt that may never come due. Is it really worth it?

items.sourceNote: 《Spring Fever》無論何時何地站在我身邊的人都是你主題告白，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我沒辦法答應你
一輩子都不吵架，

也沒辦法答應你
每天都很浪漫。

我能答應的只有一件事：

不管在哪裡，
不管是什麼時候，

你一轉頭，

站在你旁邊的
那個人，

都會是我。

這件事
我做得到，

而且我打算
做一輩子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個你想認真牽一輩子的人——不是華麗的承諾，是「你回頭我都在」的那種篤定
variations: 更短：我不保證天天浪漫，但我保證你一回頭，我都在。
延伸：別人給你星星月亮，我只想給你一個不會消失的肩膀。

en.content:
I can't promise you
we'll never fight.

I can't promise you
every day will be romantic.

There's only one thing
I can promise:

No matter where we are,
no matter when it is,

every time you turn your head,

the person
standing beside you

will be me.

That much
I can do.

And I intend
to do it
for the rest of my life.
en.editorNote: Send to the person you actually want to hold on to for life — not a flashy vow, just the quiet certainty of 'turn around and I'm here'
variations: Shorter: I can't promise romance every day. I can promise that every time you turn around, I'm there.
Extended: others will offer you the stars and the moon. I just want to give you a shoulder that never disappears.

items.sourceNote: 《Bon Appetit, Your Majesty》想你與肚子餓的錯亂告白，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我最近搞不清楚一件事：

到底是因為肚子餓，
所以一直想到你，

還是因為一直想到你，

才會覺得肚子空空的。

這兩件事
對我來說
已經是同一件了。

所以下次
如果我說「我餓了」，

你可以直接翻譯成

「我想你了」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個曖昧中、你想戳一下的人——用「肚子餓」當掩護的告白，被拆穿也不會太尷尬
variations: 更短：我分不清是餓了還是想你了，反正兩種感覺都是空空的，只有你能填。
延伸：以後我傳「吃飽沒」不是關心你有沒有吃，是想確認你今天有沒有想到我。

en.content:
Lately I can't tell one thing apart:

Am I thinking about you
because I'm hungry,

or am I hungry

because I keep thinking about you?

Honestly,
at this point
they're the same thing.

So next time
if I say "I'm hungry,"

you can just translate it as

"I miss you."
en.editorNote: Send to the person you're in a slow-burn thing with — a confession disguised as being hungry, so it's not too awkward if they dodge it
variations: Shorter: I can't tell if I'm hungry or missing you. Either way I feel empty, and only you fill it.
Extended: from now on, 'did you eat?' isn't me checking your meals. It's me checking if you thought about me today.

items.sourceNote: 《When Life Gives You Tangerines》地下室聖誕樹也閃閃發光意象，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
一棵聖誕樹，

擺在沒人會經過的
地下室角落，

還是照樣
閃閃發光。

它不會因為
沒有人看，

就決定
今天不亮了。

你也是。

就算現在
沒有人在看你，

你身上那些好的東西，

也一件都沒有
因此消失。

該亮的時候，
你會亮的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個覺得自己「還沒被看見、努力好像沒意義」的朋友——價值不需要觀眾才成立
variations: 更短：沒人看的時候你還是發光的，燈不會因為沒觀眾就熄。
延伸：不是你不夠亮，是還沒走到那個有人抬頭的角落而已。

en.content:
A Christmas tree,

tucked in a basement corner
where no one walks by,

still
lights up.

It doesn't decide
to stay dark today

just because
nobody's watching.

Neither should you.

Even if
no one's looking at you
right now,

not one of the good things
in you

disappeared because of it.

When it's time to shine,
you will.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who feels unseen, like their effort doesn't count yet — worth doesn't need an audience to be real
variations: Shorter: you still glow when no one's watching. The light doesn't switch off just because the room is empty.
Extended: it's not that you aren't bright enough. You just haven't reached the corner where someone finally looks up.

items.sourceNote: 《淚之女王》愛是一起撐過痛、選擇留下而非逃走，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我以前以為
愛情就是

每天都很甜、
說很多好聽的話。

後來才發現，

真正的愛
是那種

事情變難的時候，

你有一百個
可以走掉的理由，

但你
還是留下來。

不是因為
沒有別條路，

是因為
那條路上

沒有我要的那個人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在磨合、想過要不要繼續的另一半——愛不是不會累，是累了還是選你
variations: 更短：我留下來不是因為沒得選，是因為別的選項裡都沒有你。
延伸：甜的時候誰都會在，難的時候還在的，才是真的。

en.content:
I used to think
love was

being sweet every day
and saying all the right things.

Later I figured out

real love
is the kind where

when things get hard,

you've got a hundred
reasons to walk away,

and you
stay anyway.

Not because
there's no other road,

but because
on every other road,

the person I want
isn't there.
en.editorNote: Send to a partner you're working through a rough patch with — love isn't never getting tired, it's choosing you even when you are
variations: Shorter: I stayed not because I had no other option, but because none of the other options had you in them.
Extended: anyone will stick around for the sweet part. The ones still here for the hard part are the real ones.

items.sourceNote: 《鬼怪》黑暗隧道沒有沒出口的、痛不會永恆意象，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
每個人
這輩子

都會開進
一段很長的隧道。

那種長到
你會開始懷疑

「這輩子
是不是再也
看不到光了。」

但你要記得
一件事：

這世界上

沒有一條隧道
是沒有出口的。

它只是

比你想的
再長一點點

而已。

繼續開，
光在前面。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個卡在低潮、覺得看不到盡頭的人——不是安慰他沒事，是提醒他隧道再長都有出口
variations: 更短：再長的隧道都有出口，它只是比你以為的長一點，繼續開就對了。
延伸：現在很黑不是因為沒有光，是因為你還在隧道中間而已。

en.content:
Everyone,
at some point,

drives into
a very long tunnel.

So long
you start to wonder

"will I ever
see light
again?"

But remember
one thing:

there is no tunnel
in this world

without an exit.

This one
is just

a little longer
than you expected.

Keep driving.
The light's up ahead.
en.editorNote: Send to someone stuck in a low point who feels like there's no end — not to say it's fine, but to remind them every tunnel has an exit
variations: Shorter: even the longest tunnel has an exit. This one's just longer than you thought. Keep driving.
Extended: it's dark right now not because there's no light, but because you're still in the middle of the tunnel.

items.sourceNote: 《我的朋友很麻煩》愛得比對方多不丟臉、值得驕傲，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
他們說
愛得比較多的那個人，

是輸的一方。

我不這麼覺得。

先喜歡上、
付出比較多、
愛得比較用力——

這些從來
不是弱點。

那代表
你的心

還敢
完整地打開，

沒有被誰
弄壞。

愛得多
沒什麼好丟臉的，

那是
很勇敢的一件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得「自己愛比較多、好像很吃虧」的朋友——愛得多不是輸，是心還沒壞
variations: 更短：先愛、愛得多，不是輸，是你的心還敢完整地打開。
延伸：計較誰愛比較多的人，通常兩邊都愛得不夠。

en.content:
They say
whoever loves more

is the one who loses.

I don't buy that.

Falling first,
giving more,
loving harder —

none of that
was ever a weakness.

It means
your heart

still dares
to open all the way,

that no one
broke it yet.

Loving a lot
is nothing to be ashamed of.

It's actually
a pretty brave thing to do.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who always feels like they love more and are getting shortchanged — loving more isn't losing, it's a heart that still works
variations: Shorter: loving first, loving more — that's not losing. It's a heart still brave enough to open all the way.
Extended: people keeping score of who loves more usually aren't loving enough on either side.

items.sourceNote: POPBEE 2026治癒系韓劇台詞整理，低潮自我照顧主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
那天加完班，
她在便利商店遇到以前的同事。

同事看了她一眼，說：

「別管別人怎麼看你了，
先把自己顧好。」

她愣了三秒，
才發現自己
已經很久沒被這樣問過。

我們花好多力氣
去當一個在別人眼裡
過得還不錯的人，

卻很少停下來
問今天的自己累不累。

今天的你先好好的，
明天的你才有力氣接手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把所有人都照顧到、只有自己被漏掉的朋友——今天先照顧你自己一次
variations: 更短：先把自己照顧好，不是自私，是明天的你還撐得住的唯一辦法。
延伸：你不需要每天都很好，你只需要今天的你，別再被自己弄得更累。

en.content:
The line in a K-drama that really gets you
usually isn't the confession.

It's the one where a character,
catches you at your most worn out
and says quietly:

"Stop worrying about how others see you.
Take care of yourself first."

We spend so much energy
looking like someone
who's doing just fine,

and keep forgetting
to ask ourselves
if we're tired today.

Let today's you be okay first.
Tomorrow's you
will have the strength to take it from there.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who takes care of everyone and is the only one left off the list — take care of yourself first, just once today
variations: Shorter: taking care of yourself first isn't selfish. It's the only way tomorrow's you still stands a chance.
Extended: you don't have to be great every day. You just have to stop wearing yourself down today.

items.sourceNote: Tatler Asia K-drama romantic lines整理，「為了見你」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
他查了時刻表。

末班車十點五十分，
他十點四十七分還在辦公室。

他把電腦闔上，
外套抓在手上就往樓下衝，
沒等電梯，
沒回任何訊息。

在月台上他喘到說不出話，
低頭看手機，
只打了三個字：

「我到了。」

那段路有多遠，
他從頭到尾都沒算過。

他只算過
怎麼樣可以
快一點站到你面前。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總說「他很忙、離很遠」來替對方找藉口的朋友——真的想見你的人，從不算距離
variations: 更短：會不會來，跟距離無關，跟他多想見你有關。
延伸：嫌遠、嫌累、嫌麻煩的那些話，翻譯過來只有一句——他其實沒那麼想見你。

en.content:
The most romantic line in a K-drama
was never "I love you."

It's the one that goes —
"If it means seeing you,
no distance is too far."

Sure, in real life
nobody drives four hundred kilometers
just to see a person.

But it's really saying
something very small:

the person who truly cares about you
doesn't do the math on distance,
doesn't call it a hassle.

They only think about
what's the fastest way
to get themselves
standing in front of you.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps excusing someone with 'he's busy, he's far away' — someone who actually wants to see you never counts the distance
variations: Shorter: whether they show up has nothing to do with distance and everything to do with how much they want to see you.
Extended: 'too far,' 'too tired,' 'too much trouble' — translated, it all means one thing: they didn't want to see you that badly.

items.sourceNote: Dcard追劇板，男二病/第二男主角症候群觀察，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
韓劇看多了，
你會得一種病，
叫「男二病」。

症狀是：
那個對女主角最好的、
默默守候的、
每次都晚一步的男二，

你會替他心疼到失眠，
甚至有點怨女主角
怎麼看不見他。

然後你突然懂了一件事——

現實裡，
你可能就是某個人的男二。

那個對別人很好、
一直在等、
但永遠差那麼一點的人。

看劇的時候替他不值，
輪到自己
卻還是選擇繼續等。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是站在原地等、把自己活成別人故事裡男二的朋友——你也值得當一次別人的男主角
variations: 更短：替男二不值的你，別把自己也活成一個沒人選的男二。
延伸：男二最可惜的不是輸，是他其實很好，只是把好都給了一個不會回頭的人。

en.content:
Watch enough K-dramas
and you catch a certain condition:
"second-lead syndrome."

Symptoms:
the guy who treats the female lead best,
who waits quietly in the background,
who's always one step too late —

you lose sleep aching for him,
and kind of resent the lead
for never seeing him.

Then it hits you —

in real life,
you might be somebody's second lead.

The one who's good to someone,
who keeps waiting,
who's always just a little too late.

You call it unfair when it's on screen,
but when it's your turn,
you still choose to keep waiting.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who's always standing in place waiting, living as the second lead in someone else's story — you deserve to be the lead of your own, just once
variations: Shorter: you ache for the second lead on screen — don't quietly become one nobody picks in real life.
Extended: the second lead's real tragedy isn't losing. It's being genuinely great, and giving all of it to someone who'll never look back.

items.sourceNote: POPBEE 2026治癒系韓劇台詞整理，「當個平凡人不丟臉」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
小時候以為，
長大就是變成很厲害的大人。

後來才發現，
光是把普通的日子過好，
就已經用盡全力了。

韓劇裡有句台詞
這樣說——

承認自己
只想當個平凡人，
一點都不丟臉。

你不是不夠努力，
你只是
終於誠實地
面對自己想要的生活。

過得平凡
不是輸給誰，

那是你
跟自己
和好了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得「自己不夠成功、活得太普通」而焦慮的朋友——把平凡的日子過好，就已經很了不起
variations: 更短：承認自己只想過平凡日子，不是沒出息，是跟自己和好了。
延伸：所謂長大，不是變得多厲害，是終於允許自己，可以只是普通地、好好地活著。

en.content:
As a kid you thought
growing up meant becoming
some impressive adult.

Later you find out
just keeping an ordinary life running
already takes everything you've got.

There's a K-drama line
that puts it like this —

admitting
you only want to be an ordinary person
is nothing to be ashamed of.

It's not that you didn't try hard enough.
It's that you finally
got honest
about the life you actually want.

Living an ordinary life
isn't losing to anyone.

It's you
making peace
with yourself.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who's anxious about not being successful enough, about living too ordinary a life — running an ordinary life well is already something
variations: Shorter: admitting you just want an ordinary life isn't giving up. It's making peace with yourself.
Extended: growing up was never about becoming impressive. It's finally letting yourself just live, plainly and well.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇經典告白台詞整理，「愛你勝過愛自己」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
「如果只能保住一個，
我會選你。」

「那你自己怎麼辦？」

「我早就想清楚了。
失去一個我這麼喜歡的人，
會比失去自己更痛。
那個我承受不起。」

她低著頭，
把他袖口那顆快掉的鈕扣
來回轉了兩圈。

「所以你以後
別再怕會不會拖累我。」

她沒有說好。

她只是
一直沒有把手鬆開。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得「自己是別人負擔」而不敢靠近的人——在真正愛你的人心裡，你從來不是選項，是答案
variations: 更短：真要二選一，我選你。因為失去你，比失去我自己還痛。
延伸：喜歡一個人到最後，你會發現，保護他這件事，早就比保護自己更本能。

en.content:
If one day
we get cornered
into choosing just one —

saving myself,
or keeping you,

I'll choose you.

It's not that I don't matter.

It's that I already know
losing someone
I love this much
hurts worse
than losing myself.

So stop worrying
about being a burden.

You're the answer
I'd lose everything
just to win
back.
en.editorNote: Send to the one who keeps their distance because they think they're a burden — to someone who truly loves you, you were never the option, you're the answer
variations: Shorter: if it's really down to one, I choose you. Losing you hurts more than losing myself.
Extended: love someone long enough and you'll notice protecting them became more instinctive than protecting yourself.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇命運/時空愛情台詞整理，「無論何時遇見都會愛上你」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
有人問我，
這世上真的有
注定好的緣分嗎？

那種
改不了、也躲不掉的
命運。

我不知道。

但我知道一件事——

不管是這輩子，
上輩子，
還是還沒到的下輩子，

不管我們
在哪個時間點
重新遇見，

我都還是會
在人群裡
一眼認出你，

然後又一次，
心甘情願地
喜歡上你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個讓你覺得「換幾百次也還是會選他」的人——有些喜歡不需要理由，因為它本身就是答案
variations: 更短：不管在哪個時空重遇，我都還是會一眼認出你，再喜歡你一次。
延伸：所謂命中注定，也許不是老天安排好的，是我每一次遇見你，都還是做同一個選擇。

en.content:
Someone asked me
if there's really such a thing
as fate written in advance.

The kind
you can't change
and can't outrun.

I don't know.

But I know this —

whether it's this life,
the one before,
or one that hasn't come yet,

no matter
which moment in time
we meet again,

I'll still
pick you out
of any crowd
at a single glance,

and fall for you,
willingly,
all over again.
en.editorNote: Send to the person you'd choose again across a hundred lifetimes — some kinds of love don't need a reason, because they are the reason
variations: Shorter: whatever life we meet again in, I'd still know you at a glance and fall for you one more time.
Extended: maybe fate isn't something the universe arranged. It's me making the same choice every single time I meet you.

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇整理，「別急著好起來、專注在能療癒你的事」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
別急著
把一個人忘掉。

你越用力
叫自己「快點好起來」，
就越好不起來。

韓劇裡有句話
我一直記得——

與其想著
怎麼盡快忘記他，
不如去做
那些真正能
讓你好起來的事。

偶爾哭一下沒關係，

但你也要
記得多笑，
多吃一頓好的，
多睡一場飽的。

療傷不是比賽，

不用比誰
先站起來，
只要你
最後有站起來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個剛失戀、正逼自己「趕快沒事」的朋友——療傷可以慢慢來，不用趕在誰的時間表上
variations: 更短：別逼自己快點好起來。偶爾哭沒關係，但也記得好好吃、好好睡、多笑一點。
延伸：忘記一個人不是靠意志力硬撐，是靠你把日子，一天一天重新過好。

en.content:
Don't rush
to forget someone.

The harder you order yourself
to "hurry up and be okay,"
the less okay you get.

There's a K-drama line
I've always kept —

instead of obsessing
over forgetting him fast,
go do the things
that actually
help you heal.

It's fine to cry
now and then,

but remember
to laugh a lot too,
eat something good,
sleep a full night.

Healing isn't a race.

Nobody's timing
who stands up first —
it only matters
that, in the end,
you stand up at all.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend fresh out of a breakup, forcing themselves to "be fine already" — healing can take its time, it doesn't run on anyone's schedule
variations: Shorter: stop forcing yourself to heal fast. Crying's fine, but eat well, sleep well, and laugh a little too.
Extended: forgetting someone isn't willpower. It's rebuilding your days, one ordinary day at a time.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇人生哲理台詞整理，「用自己的標準過得快樂就好」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你有沒有發現，
我們好累，
是因為一直
用別人的尺
在量自己的人生。

他年薪多少、
她幾歲結婚、
誰又買房了——

量來量去，
怎麼量
都覺得自己不夠。

韓劇裡有句台詞
點醒了我——

能用
自己的標準
過得快樂，
這樣就夠了吧？

幸福
本來就沒有
統一的答案。

你覺得好，
那就是好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總拿別人的進度表焦慮自己的朋友——幸福沒有標準答案，你覺得好就是真的好
variations: 更短：能用自己的標準過得開心，就夠了。幸福本來就沒有統一答案。
延伸：別人的人生是別人的尺，量不出你的好。你覺得踏實，那才是你真正要的。

en.content:
Have you noticed
we're so exhausted
because we keep measuring
our own lives
with someone else's ruler?

His salary,
her wedding age,
who just bought a place —

measure and measure,
and somehow
we always come up short.

There's a K-drama line
that snapped me out of it —

being happy
by my own standards
is all I really need,
isn't it?

There was never
one right answer
to happiness.

If it feels good to you,
then it's good.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who measures their worth against everyone else's timeline — happiness has no right answer, if it feels good to you, it genuinely is
variations: Shorter: being happy by your own standards is enough. Happiness was never a one-size-fits-all answer.
Extended: someone else's life is someone else's ruler. It can't measure your good. If it feels solid to you, that's the life you actually want.

items.sourceNote: 《陛下的御膳房》台詞整理，「想你」與「餓」分不清主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
晚上十一點，
他站在冰箱前面，
門開著，
冷氣一直往外漏。

他看了大概三十秒。

裡面有蛋、有優格、
還有半罐辣椒醬。

他一樣都沒拿，
把門關上，
拿起手機打了一行字：

「我搞不清楚了，
到底是肚子餓才想到你，
還是想到你才覺得肚子餓？」

按下傳送的時候他才發現，

自己其實一點都不餓。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個你三餐都會想到的人——最甜的告白不是我愛你，是連自己怎麼了都搞不清楚，只好都怪你
variations: 更短：我分不清是餓了才想你，還是想你才覺得餓。反正最後都是你的錯。
延伸：喜歡你之後，我連飽或餓都搞不清楚了，唯一確定的只有一件事：滿腦子都是你。

en.content:
When you like someone,
your body starts
glitching in the weirdest way.

A K-drama lead
put it like this —

"I honestly can't tell anymore.
Am I thinking about you
because I'm hungry,

or am I hungry
because I keep
thinking about you?"

The sweetest confession
was never "I love you."

It's not being able to tell
what's even happening
in your own body,

so you just
pin the whole thing
on them.
en.editorNote: Send to the person you think about at every meal — the sweetest confession isn't 'I love you,' it's not knowing what's wrong with you and just blaming them for all of it
variations: Shorter: I can't tell if I'm hungry because I miss you, or missing you because I'm hungry. Either way, it's your fault.
Extended: ever since I liked you I can't tell full from hungry anymore. The one thing I'm sure of is that my whole head is just you.

items.sourceNote: 《月河》台詞整理，「在心裡重新扎根」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
她把那盆植物搬到門外，
連土帶盆丟進垃圾袋。

三個月後，
她在同一個位置掃地，

掃到一小截根，
白白的，還活著。

她蹲下來看了很久。

沒有丟掉。

她去廚房裝了半杯水，
把那截根放進去，

放在窗台上，
一個每天都會經過的地方。

你以為早就拔乾淨了。

其實根一直都在，

只等他一個轉身，
又整片長回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個以為早就翻篇、卻在重逢瞬間破功的自己——有些人你以為拔乾淨了，其實根一直都在
variations: 更短：你為什麼又在我心裡重新扎根了？我以為拔乾淨了，原來根一直都在。
延伸：不是我沒放下，是你回來的那一刻，整片感情又長回來了。有些根，本來就拔不掉。

en.content:
The hardest thing
to guard against
isn't a new crush.

It's the person
you were sure
you'd let go of
coming back.

A K-drama line
asks it like this —

"Why are you
putting down roots
in my heart
all over again?"

Roots is a brutal word
to use here,

because what it means is:

you thought
you'd pulled them all out,

but the roots
were there the whole time,

just waiting for them
to turn around
so the whole thing
could grow back.
en.editorNote: Send to the you who thought this chapter was closed, until one reunion undid it — some people you think you've uprooted, but the roots were there the whole time
variations: Shorter: why are you putting down roots in my heart again? I thought I'd pulled them all out — turns out they never left.
Extended: it's not that I didn't let you go. The moment you came back, the whole thing grew back. Some roots just can't be pulled out.

items.sourceNote: 《春日狂想》台詞整理，「無論何時何地身邊都是你」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
有些情話
聽起來很簡單，
卻是一輩子的分量。

有句韓劇台詞
只講了一件事——

「不管在哪裡，
不管什麼時候，

我身邊的那個人，
都會是你。」

它沒有
轟轟烈烈，

沒有
海枯石爛，

只是很篤定地
把「你」

寫進了
未來的
每一個場景。

最深的愛
不是激情，

是我已經
替我們
預設好了
所有的以後。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個你已經想好要一起走很久的人——最深的愛不是激情，是我把你寫進了未來的每一個畫面
variations: 更短：不管在哪裡、不管什麼時候，我身邊的人都會是你。這句話，是一輩子的分量。
延伸：我不需要海枯石爛，我只知道未來每個場景裡，站在我旁邊的都是你。

en.content:
Some love lines
sound so simple,
but carry a whole lifetime.

A K-drama line
says just one thing —

"Wherever it is,
and whenever it is,

the one beside me
will be you."

No grand drama,

no till-the-seas-run-dry,

just a quiet certainty
that writes 'you'

into every scene
of the future.

The deepest love
isn't passion —

it's that I've already
penciled you into
all of my afters.
en.editorNote: Send to the person you've already decided to walk a long way with — the deepest love isn't passion, it's writing you into every frame of the future
variations: Shorter: wherever, whenever — the one beside me will be you. That one line carries a whole lifetime.
Extended: I don't need grand promises. I just know that in every scene of my future, the one standing next to me is you.

items.sourceNote: 《某一天滅亡來到我家門前》台詞整理，「你只要愛自己，剩下的我來愛」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我們常常
把自己逼得很緊：

要更好、
要值得被愛、
要先把自己
變得完整
才敢靠近別人。

有句韓劇台詞
卻反過來說——

「你只要
好好愛自己
就好，

剩下的，
讓我來愛。」

原來真正的愛
不是要你
先變完美，

而是有個人
願意
接手你
愛不動的部分。

你負責
對自己溫柔，

其他的，
有人扛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得自己不夠好、不敢被愛的人——你只要好好愛自己，剩下的讓別人來愛你，你不用一個人扛完全部
variations: 更短：你只要好好愛自己就好，剩下的讓我來愛。你不用先變完美，才值得被愛。
延伸：你愛不動自己的那些部分，我來接手。你負責對自己溫柔，其他的交給我。

en.content:
We're always
pushing ourselves hard:

be better,
be worthy of love,
fix yourself into
something whole
before you dare
get close to anyone.

But a K-drama line
turns it around —

"You just
focus on loving
yourself well.

The rest,
let me love
for you."

Turns out real love
isn't asking you
to be perfect first.

It's someone
willing to take over
the parts
you can't manage
to love.

You handle
being gentle
with yourself.

The rest,
someone else
will carry.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who always feels they aren't good enough to be loved — you just focus on loving yourself, and let someone love the rest; you don't have to carry it all alone
variations: Shorter: you just love yourself well. The rest, let me love. You don't have to be perfect first to deserve love.
Extended: the parts of yourself you can't manage to love — I'll take those. You be gentle with you, and leave the rest to me.

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇金句整理，「快樂只有自己能給」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你有沒有發現，
你總是在等：

等他回訊息，
你才敢開心；
等對方點頭，
你才敢放鬆；
等別人說「你很好」，
你才願意相信。

有句韓劇台詞
很輕地問了一句——

「你的快樂，
為什麼
要拿去問別人？」

那一刻你才發現，
你把開心的開關
交到了別人手上，

然後怪自己
為什麼
一直不快樂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個情緒總是被別人一句話牽著走的朋友——快樂的開關拿回自己手上，別人只是路過，不該決定你今天過得好不好
variations: 更短：你的快樂為什麼要問別人？開關在你手上，別再交出去了。
延伸：等別人給你快樂，你會等很久；自己給自己，隨時都有。

en.content:
Have you noticed
you're always waiting:

waiting for his reply
before you let yourself be happy,
waiting for their nod
before you relax,
waiting for someone to say
"you're enough"
before you believe it.

A K-drama line
asks it so gently —

"Your happiness,
why are you
asking other people for it?"

And that's when you see
you handed the switch
to someone else,

then blamed yourself
for never
feeling happy.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend whose whole mood hangs on one message from someone else — take the switch back; other people are just passing through, they don't get to decide how your day goes
variations: Shorter: your happiness — why ask other people for it? The switch is in your hand. Stop giving it away.
Extended: wait for others to make you happy and you'll wait a long time. Give it to yourself and it's always in stock.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇告白台詞整理，「我一直很理智，直到看見極光」主題，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我這個人，
一向很冷靜。

再喜歡的東西，
我都能
算好距離、
收好情緒、
假裝沒事。

可是遇到你之後，
我最後一點理智
也弄丟了——

我開始在
不可能的地方
看見不可能的畫面：
白天的天空
出現了極光。

所以這不是別的，

這是我
在跟你告白。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個讓你連自己都認不出來的人——最理智的人失控的樣子，就是最誠實的告白
variations: 更短：我一向很冷靜，直到遇見你。現在我大白天都能看見極光——這就是我在跟你告白。
延伸：我本來很會收情緒的，是你把我的理智弄丟的，你要負責。

en.content:
I'm the calm type.

No matter how much
I like something,
I can
measure the distance,
tuck the feelings away,
act like it's nothing.

But after meeting you,
I lost
my last bit of sense —

I've started
seeing impossible things
in impossible places:
an aurora
in the middle of a
bright afternoon sky.

So this isn't anything else.

This is me
confessing
to you.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who made you unrecognizable to yourself — the most composed people losing it is the most honest confession there is
variations: Shorter: I'm the calm type — until you. Now I see auroras in broad daylight. That's me confessing.
Extended: I used to be so good at hiding how I feel. You're the one who lost my sanity, so you're responsible for it.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《陛下，請用膳》台詞整理，「想你還是餓」主題，情話改編

zh-tw.content:
我最近
遇到一個很嚴重的問題：

我分不清
自己到底是
肚子餓，
還是在想你。

因為每次
想到你的時候，
我的心
就會咕嚕叫，

每次肚子餓的時候，
第一個
浮出來的
又是你的臉。

所以你可以
幫我確認一下嗎——

我這到底
是餓，
還是喜歡你？
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一想到就會嘴角上揚的曖昧對象——土到讓對方笑出來，但笑完會偷偷記在心裡
variations: 更短：我分不清是肚子餓還是在想你，你可以過來讓我確認一下嗎？
延伸：醫生說我這叫相思，但我覺得比較像餓——反正兩個都是因為你。

en.content:
I've run into
a serious problem lately:

I can't tell
whether I'm
hungry,
or thinking about you.

Because every time
I think of you,
my stomach
growls,

and every time
I'm hungry,
the first thing
that surfaces
is your face.

So could you
help me confirm something —

is this
hunger,
or do I just like you?
en.editorNote: Send to the crush who makes you smile just by crossing your mind — cheesy enough to make them laugh, and they'll quietly file it away afterward
variations: Shorter: I can't tell if I'm hungry or thinking about you. Come here and help me check?
Extended: the doctor says it's lovesickness, but it feels more like hunger — either way, it's your fault.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《苦盡柑來遇見你》主題，「你總是逗我笑，我卻沒看見你的難過」遺憾核心，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你總是有辦法
讓我笑出來。

再糟的一天，
再爛的心情，
只要你在，
我就會不小心笑場。

可是我後來才發現：

我笑得那麼開，
卻從來沒問過你——

你今天，
過得好不好？

你把難過
都藏在讓我笑的那些話裡，
而我，
一次都沒有拆開來看。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是逗大家開心、卻很少說自己累的朋友——讓他知道，這次換你問他過得好不好
variations: 更短：你負責讓我笑，那誰來問你難不難過？這次讓我來。
延伸：原來最會逗人笑的人，往往最不擅長說自己在撐——對不起，我太晚才發現。

en.content:
You always found a way
to make me laugh.

Worst day,
foulest mood —
if you were there,
I'd crack up despite myself.

But here's what I only realized later:

I laughed that freely,
and not once did I ask you —

how was your day,
really?

You tucked your sadness
inside the very jokes that made me smile,
and I never once
unfolded them to look.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps everyone laughing but rarely admits they're tired — let them know it's your turn to ask how they're doing
variations: Shorter: you handle making me laugh — so who asks whether you're okay? Let me, this time.
Extended: turns out the person best at making others laugh is often the worst at saying they're barely holding on. I'm sorry I saw it so late.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《鬼怪》「날이 적당해서 모든 게 좋았다」主題，平凡日常的圓滿感，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
後來我常常想起
那些沒有發生什麼事的日子。

天氣剛剛好，
不太熱，也不太冷。

我的心情剛剛好，
沒有特別開心，
也沒有什麼好難過。

我們只是坐著，
喝著會涼掉的咖啡，
說些不重要的話。

那時候我沒發現，

原來所謂幸福，
不是什麼大事——

就是那些
剛剛好的、
什麼都沒發生的
下午。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個陪你度過很多平凡午後的人——讓他知道，那些看似什麼都沒發生的日子，其實是你最想留住的
variations: 更短：天氣剛剛好，你在旁邊，那天什麼都沒發生——這就是我最想回去的一天。
延伸：長大之後才懂，人生最奢侈的不是驚喜，是一個平凡到不用記得、卻怎麼都忘不掉的下午。

en.content:
Lately I keep thinking back
to the days when nothing happened.

The weather was just right —
not too warm, not too cold.

My mood was just right —
nothing to be thrilled about,
nothing to grieve.

We just sat there,
letting the coffee go cold,
talking about nothing that mattered.

I didn't notice it then,

but it turns out happiness
isn't some grand event —

it's those
just-right afternoons
when absolutely nothing
happened.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who spent all those ordinary afternoons with you — let them know the days that seemed empty are the ones you most want to keep
variations: Shorter: the weather was just right, you were next to me, and nothing happened — that's the day I'd go back to.
Extended: growing up teaches you the real luxury isn't surprises. It's an afternoon so ordinary you shouldn't remember it — and never quite forget.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《無法翻譯的愛》(Can This Love Be Translated?) 2026 翻譯與愛主題，「有些心意翻不出來」，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我很會翻譯。

再難的句子，
再拗口的語言，
我都能找到
最貼切的那個字。

可是有一種東西，
我翻了很多次，
還是翻不出來——

就是每次看到你，
心裡那句
說不清楚的話。

它不是「喜歡」，
也不只是「想見你」，

它是一種
沒有對應詞的感覺。

所以我決定不翻了，
直接把原文
交給你——

這句，
只有你能看懂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個讓你詞窮的曖昧對象——當所有形容詞都不夠用的時候，這句剛剛好
variations: 更短：有些心意翻不出來，因為它本來就只寫給你一個人看。
延伸：語言有極限，但我對你的感覺沒有——翻不出來的部分，就用一輩子慢慢說給你聽。

en.content:
I'm good at translating.

The hardest sentence,
the most tangled language —
I can always find
the word that fits.

But there's one thing
I've tried to translate over and over,
and still can't —

the line in my chest
every time I see you,
the one I can't quite say.

It isn't "I like you,"
it isn't just "I miss you" —

it's a feeling
with no matching word.

So I've decided to stop translating
and just hand you
the original —

this line,
only you can read.
en.editorNote: Send to the crush who leaves you at a loss for words — for when every adjective falls short, this one fits
variations: Shorter: some feelings can't be translated — because they were only ever written for you to read.
Extended: language has limits; what I feel for you doesn't. The part I can't translate, I'll spend a lifetime slowly telling you.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《Start-Up 我的新創時代》拌泡麵告白場景，笨拙又真誠的告白，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我知道這個時機
很不對。

我正在拌泡麵，
手上還沾著醬料，
瀏海也塌了，
完全不是電視劇會出現的畫面。

可是我怕再等下去，
又會找藉口說「下次再說」，
然後就沒有下次了。

所以我還是說了：

我喜歡你。

你不用馬上回答，
也不用有任何負擔，
我只是想讓你知道——

就算是在拌泡麵的時候，
我想到的
也是你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直在等「完美時機」告白的朋友——現實裡最好的時機，就是你終於敢開口的那一刻
variations: 更短：手上還沾著泡麵醬，瀏海也塌了，但我還是要說：我喜歡你。
延伸：電視劇的告白有BGM有慢動作，我的只有一碗快要糊掉的泡麵——可是我是認真的，比任何一集都認真。

en.content:
I know the timing
is all wrong.

I'm mixing instant noodles,
sauce still on my fingers,
bangs gone flat —
nothing like the scene they'd put on TV.

But I'm scared that if I wait,
I'll talk myself into "next time,"
and then there won't be one.

So I'm saying it anyway:

I like you.

You don't have to answer now,
you don't have to carry anything —
I just want you to know —

even while I'm mixing noodles,
the one I'm thinking of
is you.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend forever waiting for the 'perfect moment' to confess — in real life the best timing is simply the moment you finally dare to speak
variations: Shorter: sauce on my fingers, bangs flat, and I'm saying it anyway — I like you.
Extended: TV confessions get a soundtrack and slow motion. Mine gets a bowl of noodles going soggy — but I mean it, more than any episode ever did.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《海岸村恰恰恰》「這世上所有東西裡，我最喜歡你」主題，把風景與人並列的告白，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我喜歡這裡的一切。

喜歡海浪拍上來的聲音，
喜歡傍晚燒起來的營火，
喜歡夏天的味道，
喜歡抬頭就有的那片星星。

可是如果要我
從這一切裡
挑一個最喜歡的——

那不是海，
不是星星，
也不是夏天。

是你。

這世界上
所有存在的東西裡，
我，
最喜歡你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個和你一起看過海、看過星星的人——把整個世界排在後面，只為了把他放在最前面
variations: 更短：海、星星、夏天我都喜歡，但這一切裡，我最喜歡的還是你。
延伸：我可以列出一百件喜歡的事，但只要你在名單上，其他九十九件都只是陪襯。

en.content:
I love everything about this place.

The sound of the waves rolling in,
the bonfire catching at dusk,
the smell of summer,
the stars that are just there when you look up.

But if I had to pick
one favorite
out of all of it —

it wouldn't be the sea,
not the stars,
not the summer.

It's you.

Out of everything
that exists in this world,
the thing I like most
is you.
en.editorNote: Send to the person you've watched the sea and the stars with — putting the whole world in second place just to keep them first
variations: Shorter: I love the sea, the stars, the summer — but out of all of it, what I like most is still you.
Extended: I could list a hundred things I love, but as long as you're on the list, the other ninety-nine are just backdrop.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《愛情如何翻譯》「我一直看到極光，這就是我在告白」主題，把心動比喻成幻覺的告白，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
我本來想撐到最後
都保持理智的。

結果我輸了。

這陣子我開始看到一些
不該存在的東西——
走在路上會突然看到極光，
明明是白天，
明明什麼都沒有。

我查過了，
這不是什麼病。

是你。

所以這句話，
就當作我在告白：
我已經瘋了，
而且是為你瘋的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個讓你連走在路上都會突然發呆的人——告訴他你的理智線，是從遇見他那天開始斷的
variations: 更短：我本來想保持理智，結果最近開始看到極光。這不是病，是你，這是我在告白。
延伸：我試過用各種理由解釋這種恍神，最後只剩一個說得通——我喜歡你，喜歡到連現實都跟著失真。

en.content:
I meant to keep it together
right to the very end.

I lost.

Lately I've been seeing things
that shouldn't be there —
auroras, in the middle of the street,
in broad daylight,
where there's clearly nothing.

I looked it up.
It isn't a condition.

It's you.

So take this as a confession:
I've gone completely mad,
and I've gone mad
over you.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who makes you space out on the sidewalk for no reason — tell them your sanity started slipping the day you met them
variations: Shorter: I tried to stay rational. Lately I keep seeing auroras. It isn't a condition — it's you. This is me confessing.
Extended: I tried every explanation for the spacing out. Only one held up — I like you, enough that even reality goes a little blurry.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《努力克服自卑的我們》寫實描寫成年人自卑與嫉妒主題，安撫疲憊心靈的療癒台詞，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你不是不夠好。

你只是太常
站在別人的高光裡
看自己的陰影，
然後以為那片陰影，
就是你的全部。

可是光會移動，
影子也會。

你羨慕的那個人，
此刻也正站在
某個他覺得自己輸掉的角落，
羨慕著別人。

沒有人是一直發光的。
只是沒有人
會把暗掉的那面
拍給你看。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總覺得自己比不上別人、深夜會emo的朋友——告訴他他看到的只是別人剪輯過的版本
variations: 更短：你不是不夠好，你只是站在別人的高光裡看自己的影子。光會移動，別急著下定論。
延伸：你羨慕的那個人，此刻也在某個角落覺得自己輸了。沒有人一直發光，只是沒人把暗的那面拍給你看。

en.content:
You're not falling short.

You've just been standing
in someone else's spotlight,
looking at your own shadow,
and mistaking that shadow
for the whole of you.

But light moves.
So do shadows.

The person you envy
is, right now,
standing in some corner
where they feel they've lost,
envying someone else.

No one glows all the time.
They just never film
the side that went dark.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who always feels like they measure up short and spirals late at night — tell them they're only seeing everyone else's edited cut
variations: Shorter: You're not falling short. You're standing in someone's spotlight staring at your own shadow. Light moves — don't call it too early.
Extended: The person you envy is, right now, in some corner feeling like they lost. No one glows all the time — they just never film the dark side.

items.sourceNote: POPBEE 2026治癒系韓劇台詞「你的幸福，為什麼要問別人？」主題，把幸福標準收回自己手上，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你的幸福，
為什麼要問別人？

你問朋友「這樣算不算成功」，
問父母「這樣夠不夠好」，
問陌生人的貼文「我是不是落後了」。

可是他們
沒有一個人
住在你的人生裡。

幸福不是考試，
沒有標準答案，
也沒有人可以幫你改考卷。

下次想問別人之前，
先問問你自己：
「我現在，過得舒服嗎？」

這一題，
只有你答得出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是拿別人的標準衡量自己、活得很累的人——把出題權和改考卷的權利，都還給他自己
variations: 更短：你的幸福為什麼要問別人？他們沒有一個住在你的人生裡。這題只有你答得出來。
延伸：幸福不是考試，沒有標準答案。別再拿別人的成績單對答案，你手上那份，只需要你自己滿意。

en.content:
Your happiness —
why are you asking other people?

You ask friends "does this count as making it,"
ask your parents "is this good enough,"
ask a stranger's post "am I falling behind."

But not one of them
actually lives
inside your life.

Happiness isn't an exam.
There's no answer key,
and no one else can grade your paper.

Before you ask anyone next time,
ask yourself first:
"Right now — am I okay?"

That's the one question
only you can answer.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who measures themselves by everyone else's ruler and is worn out by it — hand the exam and the grading pen back to them
variations: Shorter: Why are you asking other people about your happiness? Not one of them lives in your life. That question is yours to answer.
Extended: Happiness isn't an exam with an answer key. Stop checking your work against someone else's grades — yours only needs to satisfy you.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇《淚之女王》婚姻與愛情主題，願為對方多活一天的長情告白，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
以前我覺得
愛一個人，
是想跟他過一輩子。

後來我才懂，
真正的愛
沒那麼浪漫。

是他生病的那天，
我會希望
我比他多活一天——

不是為了誰先誰後，
是因為我不想
讓他一個人
面對最後那段路。

這種話說不出口，
所以我只做一件事：
每天，
比昨天再多愛你一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個你想牽著走完全程的人——最深的情話往往不浪漫，只是願意站在後面，替對方擋住最難的那一段
variations: 更短：真正的愛不浪漫，是我希望比你多活一天，只為了不讓你一個人走最後那段。
延伸：我不需要轟轟烈烈，我只想每天比昨天再多愛你一點——愛到最後，連時間都不忍心把我們分開。

en.content:
I used to think
loving someone
meant wanting a whole life with them.

Later I understood
real love
isn't that romantic.

It's that on the day they fall ill,
I'd wish
to outlive them by a single day —

not about who goes first,
but because I can't stand
letting them walk
that last stretch alone.

You can't say a thing like that out loud,
so I just do one thing:
love you, every day,
a little more than the day before.
en.editorNote: Send to the person you want to walk the whole way with — the deepest love lines aren't romantic, just a quiet willingness to stand behind them and take the hardest part
variations: Shorter: Real love isn't romantic. It's wishing I'd outlive you by one day, just so you never walk the last stretch alone.
Extended: I don't need sweeping and dramatic. I just want to love you a little more each day than the last — until even time can't bear to part us.

items.sourceNote: 2026韓劇追劇文化觀察，季末等待更新的追劇心理，原創改編幽默

zh-tw.content:
追一部週更韓劇
最痛苦的
不是等更新。

是你在星期六看完
那個要命的結尾之後——

要用整整七天，
假裝自己是一個
正常運作的成年人。

上班、吃飯、跟人聊天，
表面若無其事，
心裡只有一個問題：

「男主角到底會不會
在下一集
轉過頭？」

這七天，
才是這部劇
真正的懸疑劇情。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個跟你一起被週更折磨、每週六晚上準時崩潰的追劇搭子——這七天你們一起熬
variations: 更短：追週更韓劇最痛的不是等更新，是看完結尾後要假裝自己是正常成年人整整七天。
延伸：別人問你在等什麼，你總不能說「等一個虛構角色轉頭」。所以你只能微笑，然後默默數還剩幾天。

en.content:
The worst part of a weekly K-drama
isn't the wait for the next episode.

It's that after Saturday,
after that killer ending —

you have to spend seven whole days
pretending to be
a functioning adult.

Work, meals, small talk,
nodding like everything's fine,
while one question loops inside:

"Is the male lead going to
turn his head
in the next episode or not?"

Those seven days
are the real
suspense arc of the show.
en.editorNote: Send to the binge buddy who suffers the weekly release with you and quietly falls apart every Saturday night — you get through the seven days together
variations: Shorter: The worst part of a weekly K-drama isn't the wait — it's faking being a functional adult for seven days after that ending.
Extended: You can't tell people you're waiting for a fictional character to turn his head. So you just smile and silently count down the days.

items.sourceNote: 《淚之女王》關於「誰先走」的告白氛圍，原創改寫，非原台詞

zh-tw.content:
有一種告白，
不談永遠，
只談那一天。

「總有一天，
我們之中會剩下一個人。

先走的那個，
就在路口等著。

這樣一來，
留下來的人
就不算是一個人走完了——

只是走得比較慢一點，
後面還有人在等。」

我們總以為
最浪漫的話是「我不會離開」。

其實最浪漫的，
是有人已經替你想好了
他不在的那一天，
還要怎麼陪你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給結婚多年、開始會聊到「以後」的另一半，或用在紀念日卡片上——比「永遠愛你」更有重量
variations: 更短：真正的承諾不是「我不會走」，是「我先走的話，會在路口等你」。
延伸：怕的從來不是死亡，是那個房間裡只剩自己的聲音。所以我們才需要有人先說好，他會在哪裡等。

en.content:
Some confessions
don't promise forever.
They plan for one specific day.

"Someday,
one of us will be the one left.

Whoever goes first
will wait at the corner.

That way
the one still here
isn't finishing the walk alone —

just walking a little slower,
with someone waiting up ahead."

We think the most romantic line
is "I'll never leave."

It isn't.
It's someone already figuring out
how to keep you company
on the day they can't.
en.editorNote: For a partner you've been with long enough to talk about "later," or an anniversary card — it lands heavier than "forever"
variations: Shorter: The real promise isn't "I won't leave." It's "if I go first, I'll wait at the corner."
Extended: What scares us isn't dying. It's the room with only your own voice in it. That's why someone has to say where they'll be waiting.

items.sourceNote: 《淚之女王》失憶題材的情感內核，原創改寫，非原台詞

zh-tw.content:
「我其實沒那麼怕
忘記自己是誰。

名字可以再學一次，
習慣可以重新養，
連我喜歡吃什麼
都可以重新試出來。

我怕的是
某天醒來看著你，
心裡還是會動一下，
卻叫不出你的名字。

所以拜託你，
那天不要急著糾正我。

就重新自我介紹一次，
讓我再喜歡你一遍。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫給正在照顧生病家人的朋友，或用在「我最怕失去的不是自己，是你」這種情緒需要出口的時候
variations: 更短：我不怕忘記自己是誰，我怕看著你心還會動，卻叫不出你的名字。
延伸：如果那天真的來了，別急著提醒我我們的過去。從第一次見面重講一遍就好，我一定還是會選你。

en.content:
"I'm not that afraid
of forgetting who I am.

I can learn my name again,
rebuild the habits,
even taste my way back
to what I used to like.

What scares me
is waking up, looking at you,
feeling my chest still move —
and not having your name.

So please,
don't rush to correct me that day.

Just introduce yourself again,
and let me fall for you
one more time."
en.editorNote: For a friend caring for a sick family member, or any moment that needs the words "what I'm scared of losing isn't me, it's you"
variations: Shorter: I'm not scared of forgetting who I am. I'm scared of looking at you, still feeling it, and not having your name.
Extended: If that day comes, don't recite our history at me. Start from the first hello. I'd pick you again anyway.

items.sourceNote: 2026韓劇《Spring Fever》長途開車見面的告白情境，原創改寫，非原台詞

zh-tw.content:
韓劇最強的告白，
通常都不是「我喜歡你」。

是這種——

「如果我沒有喜歡你，
我會半夜求我哥
開四百公里的車
只為了看你一眼嗎？

我還幫他加了油、
買了咖啡、
聽他罵我一路。

你自己算算，
這個成本
哪一項像是
不喜歡你的人
會付的？」

真心不用形容詞。
看行程表就知道了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個明明做了一堆事、卻死不承認喜歡對方的朋友，也適合當作自己鼓起勇氣的開場白
variations: 更短：如果我沒喜歡你，我會半夜拜託我哥開四百公里的車，只為了看你一眼嗎？
延伸：喜歡一個人是有帳單的。油錢、睡眠、面子，全部刷下去也沒喊過一次貴。

en.content:
The best K-drama confessions
almost never start with "I like you."

They sound like this —

"If I didn't like you,
would I have begged my brother
to drive four hundred kilometers
at midnight
just to see your face?

I paid for his gas.
I bought him coffee.
I let him lecture me the whole way.

You do the math.
Which part of that bill
looks like something
someone who doesn't like you
would pay?"

Real feelings don't need adjectives.
Just check the receipts.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who has done twelve unhinged things for someone and still insists it's nothing — or use it as your own opening line
variations: Shorter: If I didn't like you, would I have begged my brother to drive four hundred kilometers at midnight just to see you?
Extended: Liking someone comes with an invoice. Gas, sleep, dignity — all charged, and not once did I call it expensive.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇安靜相處場景的情感內核（聽心跳／不必說話），原創改寫，非原台詞

zh-tw.content:
韓劇最好看的，
其實不是雨中那一幕。

是兩個人窩在沙發上，
電視在演什麼都沒人在看，
誰也沒說話。

沒有台詞，
沒有配樂，
只有一個人的呼吸
慢慢跟另一個人
對上了節奏。

愛情最後不會停在
最激烈的那一場戲。

它會停在
你終於可以
在一個人面前
什麼都不用說，
也不覺得尷尬的那一秒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個「跟你一起發呆也不會冷場」的人，也適合用在交往一段時間後、想說些不肉麻的告白
variations: 更短：愛情不會停在最激烈的那場戲，會停在你不用說話也不尷尬的那一秒。
延伸：熱戀時我們比誰話多，後來才發現，能一起安靜半小時的人，比較難找。

en.content:
The best part of a K-drama
isn't the scene in the rain.

It's two people on a couch,
something playing that neither is watching,
neither of them talking.

No lines.
No score.
Just one person's breathing
slowly syncing up
with someone else's.

Love doesn't end up
in the loudest scene.

It ends up in the second
where you can finally
say nothing at all
in front of someone
and not feel weird about it.
en.editorNote: For the person you can sit in silence with — or for a low-key confession once you're past the honeymoon stage
variations: Shorter: Love doesn't end in the loudest scene. It ends in the second where silence stops feeling awkward.
Extended: Early on we competed to talk. Later you realize someone you can be quiet with for half an hour is the rarer find.

items.sourceNote: 《請回答1988》關於時間的金句「重點不是你有多少時間，而是你怎麼用」延伸改寫，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡有一句話，
年輕的時候聽會滑過去，
過了三十歲再聽會突然安靜下來：

「重點從來不是
你還剩多少時間，
是你打算怎麼用它。」

我們花好多力氣
計算自己還來不來得及，
卻很少真的
把今天這一天
過成自己想要的樣子。

時間不會等你準備好，
它只會等你開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直說「等我準備好」「等有空再說」的朋友——他缺的從來不是時間，是開始
variations: 更短的版本：你不是沒時間，你只是把時間都花在擔心自己沒時間
延伸：真正浪費時間的，不是發呆的那個下午，是你花整整一年反覆糾結一件五分鐘就能決定的事

en.content:
There's a K-drama line
you skim past when you're young,
then it stops you cold after thirty:

"It was never about
how much time you have left.
It's about how you plan to spend it."

We pour so much energy
into calculating whether we're too late,
and almost never actually
live today
the way we say we want to.

Time won't wait for you to be ready.
It only waits for you to start.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who keeps saying 'once I'm ready' or 'when I have time' — what they're missing isn't time, it's the starting
variations: Shorter: You're not out of time. You just spend all your time worrying about being out of time.
Extended: The real waste isn't the afternoon you spent doing nothing. It's the whole year you spent circling a decision that took five minutes to make.

items.sourceNote: Melo Movie生活系韓劇的愛情內核，喜歡一個人像重看最愛的電影主題，原創改寫，非原台詞

zh-tw.content:
喜歡上一個人，
有點像重看一部
你早就知道結局的電影。

你知道哪裡會笑、
哪裡會有點難過、
甚至知道他下一句要說什麼。

可是你還是
每次都按下播放，
每次都看到最後。

愛不是因為不知道結局才留下來，
是明明都知道了，
還是選你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個交往很久、覺得「新鮮感沒了」的朋友——熟到能背出對方的台詞，還是想再看一次，那才是愛
variations: 更土的告白版：你是我唯一一部，知道結局還想重看一百次的電影
延伸：新鮮感會過期，但「就算全部都看過了、還是選你」這件事不會

en.content:
Falling for someone
is a bit like rewatching a movie
whose ending you already know.

You know where you'll laugh,
where it gets a little sad,
you can even mouth their next line.

And still,
every single time,
you press play and stay till the credits.

Love isn't staying because you don't know how it ends.
It's knowing exactly how it ends
and choosing them anyway.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who thinks the spark is gone after a few years — knowing someone's lines by heart and still wanting a rewatch is the love part
variations: Cheesier confession: You're the only movie I'd rewatch a hundred times knowing exactly how it ends.
Extended: The novelty expires. 'I've seen all of it and I still choose you' doesn't.

items.sourceNote: POPBEE 2026治癒系韓劇台詞，關於「撐過去以後才發現自己變強」的內核，原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡有一句話，
是講給正在硬撐的人聽的：

「現在讓你這麼難受的事，
總有一天會慢慢平息、慢慢過去。
撐到那一天，
你會發現自己
已經變得比想像中更強了。」

最溫柔的地方在於——
它沒有叫你「現在就要堅強」。

變強從來不是在痛的當下感覺到的，
是等你回頭看，
才發現自己居然走過來了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個正在低潮、覺得自己撐不下去的人——不用現在就變強，撐著就好，變強是之後才會發現的事
variations: 更短的版本：你不是要立刻好起來，你只要撐到它自己過去
延伸：那些你以為熬不過的事，後來都變成別人問你「你怎麼撐過來的」——而你自己也答不太出來

en.content:
There's a K-drama line
meant for the ones white-knuckling it right now:

"Whatever's crushing you today
will settle and pass, little by little.
Hang on until then,
and you'll find you've become
stronger than you thought."

The gentle part is this:
it never tells you to 'be strong now.'

Strength was never something you feel mid-pain.
It's what you notice
looking back,
realizing you somehow made it through.
en.editorNote: Send to someone in a low place who feels like they can't hold on — you don't have to be strong now, just hang on; the strength is something you notice later
variations: Shorter: You don't have to get better right now. You just have to outlast it.
Extended: The things you were sure would break you become the thing people ask 'how did you get through that?' — and you can't quite explain it either.

items.sourceNote: 2026韓劇迷追劇文化觀察，關於追久了開始不用看字幕的現象，原創改編幽默

zh-tw.content:
你知道你已經追太多韓劇，
是在哪一刻嗎？

是某一集裡，
角色開口說了一句話，
你在字幕還沒跳出來之前，
就已經聽懂了。

你沒學過韓文，
你只是「追出來的」。

「歐爸」「大丈夫」「真的假的」
這些你比五十音還熟。

沒有人發過證書給你，
但你知道，
你早就畢業了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上說「我韓文不好」、卻能在字幕出來前就聽懂台詞的朋友——這叫實戰派
variations: 更進一步：你甚至會在朋友看漏台詞的時候幫忙補一句「他剛說的是……」，然後補完才想起自己根本不會韓文
延伸：真正的重症患者，是連片頭那句製作公司名都能跟著唸出來

en.content:
You know the moment
you've watched too many K-dramas?

It's when a character speaks a line,
and before the subtitle even loads,
you already understood it.

You never studied Korean.
You just... binge-absorbed it.

'Oppa,' 'jinjja,' 'aigoo,' 'saranghae' —
you know these better than the alphabet.

Nobody handed you a certificate,
but deep down you know:
you graduated a long time ago.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who insists 'my Korean is terrible' but catches every line before the subtitle appears — that's the field-experience track
variations: Next level: you fill in a line your friend missed — 'he just said…' — and only afterward remember you don't actually speak Korean.
Extended: The truly far-gone ones can chant along with the production company name in the opening credits.

items.sourceNote: 2026治癒系韓劇《努力克服自卑的我們》主題，成年人的自卑與比較，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
2026年有一部韓劇專門講「自卑」，
裡面有一句話很多人截圖：

「你不是不夠好，
你只是一直拿自己
最普通的那一面，
去比別人
特意給你看的那一面。」

你看完愣了一下，
因為你每天都在做這件事——
用你的幕後花絮，
去比別人的預告片。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一打開社群軟體就開始覺得自己很失敗的朋友——提醒他別人放上來的都是精選過的
variations: 更狠的後半段：你羨慕的那個人，此刻可能正在羨慕別人——這條比較的隊伍，其實沒有人站在最前面
延伸版：真正的問題不是你不夠好，是你根本沒定義過「夠好」是什麼樣子，所以永遠都到不了

en.content:
There's a 2026 K-drama entirely about feeling inferior,
and one line got screenshotted everywhere:

"You're not not-good-enough.
You've just been holding up
your most ordinary side
against the side
other people chose to show you."

You paused after that,
because you do it every single day —
comparing your behind-the-scenes footage
to everyone else's trailer.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who opens social media and immediately feels like a failure — remind them everyone else posted the highlight reel
variations: The colder follow-up: the person you envy is probably envying someone else right now — nobody is actually standing at the front of this line.
Extended: the real problem isn't that you're not good enough — it's that you never defined what 'enough' looks like, so you can never arrive.

items.sourceNote: 第二男主角反向梗——現實裡你是自己人生的男二，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
看韓劇你會替男二不平：
「他那麼好，為什麼女主不選他？」

看久了才發現一個更難的真相：

在你自己的人生裡，
你也是那個男二。

你溫柔、你可靠、
你記得每一個細節、
你在對方需要的時候剛好出現——

然後對方轉身，
跑去追那個讓他淋雨的人。

沒有BGM，
沒有慢動作，
只有你站在原地，
說：「沒事，我懂。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是當「好人」、總是被感謝但沒被選的朋友——用自嘲的方式陪他笑一下
variations: 更痛的一句：男二至少還有觀眾心疼，現實裡的你連個替你抱不平的人都沒有
反轉版：但韓劇也沒演的是——男二後來自己拍了一部劇，在那部劇裡他是唯一的主角

en.content:
Watching K-dramas, you root for the second lead:
"He's so good — why won't she pick him?"

Watch enough of them
and a harder truth shows up:

in your own life,
you're the second lead too.

You're gentle, you're reliable,
you remember every little detail,
you show up exactly when they need someone —

and then they turn around
and chase the one who left them in the rain.

No BGM,
no slow motion,
just you standing there
saying, "It's fine, I get it."
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who's always the 'good one' — always thanked, never chosen — and let them laugh at it with you
variations: The sharper line: at least the second lead has an audience aching for him. In real life, nobody's even rooting for you out loud.
The flip: what the drama never shows is the second lead going off to make his own show — and in that one, he's the only lead.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇喝醉被背回家橋段，反差現實原創改編

zh-tw.content:
韓劇教你一件事：
只要你喝醉，
就會有個帥氣的男人
二話不說把你背起來，
一路走回家，
背上很穩，語氣還很寵。

現實是：
你喝醉了，
自己叫了車，
上車前傳了一則
不該傳的訊息給前任，
隔天早上
對著手機螢幕想原地消失。

那個會背你的男主角，
韓劇一直沒說
他到底在哪一集出現。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個週末又要去喝的朋友——提醒他喝醉之前，先把前任的對話框關掉
variations: 進階版：韓劇裡喝醉是可愛，會撒嬌、會說真心話；現實裡喝醉是災難，會發限動、會打十通電話——醒來只想刪帳號

en.content:
K-dramas taught you one thing:
get drunk, and a handsome man
will silently crouch down,
hoist you onto his back,
and carry you all the way home —
steady the whole time,
voice impossibly gentle.

Reality:
you get drunk,
you order your own ride,
and right before you climb in
you text your ex
something you absolutely shouldn't have,
then spend the next morning
wanting to disappear into your phone screen.

The guy who piggybacks you home —
K-dramas never mention
which episode he actually shows up in.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend heading out drinking this weekend — remind them to close the ex's chat before the first glass
variations: Upgrade: in K-dramas, drunk is cute — you get clingy, you confess your real feelings. In real life, drunk is a disaster — you post a story, you make ten calls, and you wake up wanting to delete the whole account.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇背後抱完美時機橋段，反差現實原創改編

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡的背後抱，
永遠出現在最剛好的時機。

你剛轉身要走，
他從後面環住你；
你話說到一半哽住，
他從後面環住你；
你以為全世界都不懂你，
他從後面環住你。

現實裡你也試過從後面抱人，
對方嚇得整杯咖啡潑出來，
回頭問你：
「你幹嘛？走路不會出聲喔？」

原來背後抱要好看，
關鍵不是角度，
是對方剛好也在等你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總在等一個完美擁抱時機的人——時機從來不是等出來的，是有人先伸手
variations: 韓劇沒拍的是：那個背後抱之所以剛剛好，是因為他在你身後站了三集、猶豫了三集，才終於敢伸出手

en.content:
In K-dramas, the back-hug
always lands at the perfect moment.

You turn to leave —
arms around you from behind.
You choke up mid-sentence —
arms around you from behind.
You're sure no one in the world gets you —
arms around you from behind.

You tried a back-hug once in real life.
The other person jumped,
spilled a whole cup of coffee,
and turned around like:
"What are you doing? Ever heard of footsteps?"

Turns out a good back-hug
isn't about the angle.
It's about the other person
quietly waiting for you too.
en.editorNote: Send to the person always waiting for the perfect moment to reach out — it never arrives on its own; someone has to move first
variations: What K-dramas leave out: that back-hug lands perfectly because he spent three whole episodes standing behind her, working up the nerve to finally raise his arms.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇打翻牛奶、重新裝滿杯子的療癒台詞，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
有句韓劇台詞，
是講給還在自責的人聽的：

「別再為那件事
懲罰自己了。
打翻的牛奶，
哭再久也裝不回去，
後悔也一樣，
它不會把時間倒帶。

你唯一能做的，
是把那個空掉的杯子，
一點一點
重新裝滿。」

不是要你假裝
什麼都沒發生，
是要你知道——
杯子空了，
不代表這輩子
就只能對著它發呆。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了一個決定反覆懊悔、走不出來的人——日子是往前裝滿的，不是往後倒帶的
variations: 換個說法：你沒辦法改寫已經翻過去的那一頁，但筆一直在你手上，下一頁還空著

en.content:
There's a K-drama line
for anyone still beating themselves up:

"Stop punishing yourself
over that one thing.
Crying over spilled milk
won't pour it back into the cup,
and neither will regret —
it doesn't rewind the clock.

The only thing you can do
is take that empty glass
and slowly,
fill it back up again."

It's not asking you to pretend
nothing happened.
It's reminding you —
an empty glass
doesn't mean you have to sit
and stare at it for the rest of your life.
en.editorNote: Send to someone stuck replaying one decision on a loop — life gets refilled going forward, not rewound going back
variations: Another way to put it: you can't rewrite the page that's already turned, but the pen is still in your hand and the next page is blank.

items.sourceNote: 追劇被演技帶哭的現象觀察，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
你知道你追韓劇
已經追到走火入魔，
是在哪一刻嗎？

是某一集，
演員只是紅了眼眶、
一句台詞都還沒說，
你就已經
先幫他哭完了。

你明明知道
那是演的、
是劇本、
是打好燈架好機的攝影棚，

可是你的眼淚
不知道啊。
它只知道
有個人很難過，
然後它就決定
陪他一起。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看劇哭到要抽整包衛生紙、還嘴硬說「我只是眼睛乾」的朋友
variations: 更慘的版本：你哭完才發現，你根本不知道這角色叫什麼名字，你只是被那張臉上的表情整個帶走

en.content:
Want to know the exact moment
you realize you're in too deep
with K-dramas?

It's the scene
where the actor's eyes just barely well up —
not a single line spoken yet —
and you've already
cried on their behalf.

You know full well
it's acting,
it's a script,
it's a soundstage with the lights
and cameras all set up.

But your tears
don't know that.
All they know
is that someone is hurting,
so they decide
to keep them company.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who goes through a whole tissue box every episode and still insists 'my eyes are just dry'
variations: Worse version: you finish crying and realize you don't even know the character's name — you just got completely swept away by the expression on that one face.

items.sourceNote: 2026 職場韓劇前輩後輩關係設定觀察，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
職場韓劇裡一定會有一個前輩。

你捅了樓子，
他先走進辦公室說「這是我讓他做的」；
你加班到十一點，
他把便利商店的三角飯糰放在你桌上，
什麼都不問就走。

現實裡你進公司第一天，
交接文件只有一份，
寫著「以下請自行摸索」。

後來你也熬成了前輩。

然後你發現，
那種人不是韓劇編出來的——
是有人決定要當，
才會存在。

所以那天新人搞砸的時候，
你聽見自己說：
「沒事，這個我來扛。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給剛升上主管、或剛帶第一個新人的朋友——你等不到的那個前輩，可以由你來當
variations: 換句話說：你以為職場沒有溫暖，其實溫暖不是被分配到的，是有人先發出來的——而那個人這次剛好是你

en.content:
Every workplace K-drama has that one senior.

You mess up,
and he walks into the office first, saying
"I told him to do it that way."
You're still at your desk at eleven,
and a convenience-store rice ball
lands next to your keyboard —
no questions, no lecture, he just leaves.

In real life, day one at your job,
the handover doc was one page long
and said "please figure out the rest yourself."

Years later, you became the senior.

And that's when you realized:
that person was never a writer's invention —
they exist only because
somebody decided to be one.

So the day the new hire panicked,
you heard yourself say:
"It's fine. I've got this one."
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who just got promoted or just got their first direct report — the mentor you never had is a role you can take
variations: Put another way: you thought the workplace had no warmth in it. Warmth isn't assigned to you — someone has to give it out first, and this time that someone is you.

items.sourceNote: 2026 七月新劇「情感轉移／共感」超現實設定，原創改編台詞

zh-tw.content:
今年夏天有部韓劇的設定很妙：
兩個人被綁在一起，
一方的情緒會直接傳到另一方身上。

他難過，你的胸口就悶；
你發抖，他的手也跟著抖。

女主角問：
「這樣不會很累嗎？
連別人的痛都要一起承受。」

男主角想了很久才回：

「累。
但我終於不用再猜
你到底好不好。

以前你說『我沒事』，
我只能相信。
現在你說『我沒事』，
我會知道你在說謊，
然後我就可以
坐下來陪你。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是回「我沒事」的人——你不用說出口，但也不用一個人撐
variations: 現實版本沒有超能力，所以我們只能笨笨地問第二次：「真的沒事嗎？」——很多人就是在第二次才肯說實話

en.content:
There's a K-drama this summer
with a strange premise:
two people get linked,
and one person's feelings
transfer straight into the other.

He grieves, your chest tightens.
You shake, his hands shake too.

She asks him:
"Doesn't that exhaust you?
Carrying someone else's pain on top of your own."

He takes a long time to answer.

"It does.
But I finally don't have to guess
whether you're okay.

Before, when you said 'I'm fine,'
all I could do was believe you.
Now when you say 'I'm fine,'
I know you're lying —
and I get to sit down
and stay with you."
en.editorNote: Send to the person whose default answer is always 'I'm fine' — you don't have to say it out loud, but you don't have to carry it alone either
variations: The real-life version has no superpower, so all we get is asking a second time — clumsily, awkwardly: "No, really. Are you okay?" Most people only tell the truth on the second ask.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇時間跳躍字卡敘事手法觀察，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
韓劇最狠的一招，
是螢幕上突然跳出四個字：

「三年後。」

上一秒還在哭到不能自已的人，
下一個鏡頭
已經在早餐店排隊、
穿著新的外套、
笑得很自然。

那三年編劇沒有拍，
因為那三年沒有畫面感——
只有很多次早上不想起床，
很多次以為自己好了又倒回去，
很多個沒人看見的普通日子。

你現在
就正在那三年裡面。

沒有配樂，
沒有跳過鍵，

但你會走到
字卡的另一邊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個覺得自己卡住太久、看不到終點的人——難熬的那段本來就沒有人會拍下來
variations: 溫柔一點的說法：你不是進度落後，你只是剛好在那段沒有被剪進正片的日子裡，而它一樣算數

en.content:
The cruelest trick K-dramas pull
is a title card that just says:

"Three years later."

One second she's crying
like she'll never stop.
Next shot, she's in line for breakfast,
new coat, easy laugh,
like none of it happened.

The writers skipped those three years
because three years of that
makes terrible television —
just a lot of mornings
she didn't want to get up,
a lot of times she thought she was healed
and slid right back,
a lot of ordinary days nobody filmed.

You are inside those three years
right now.

No soundtrack.
No skip button.

But you do come out
the other side of the card.
en.editorNote: Send to someone convinced they've been stuck too long — the hard stretch was never going to be the part anyone filmed
variations: Gentler version: you're not behind schedule. You're just living through the footage that didn't make the final cut, and it counts exactly the same.

items.sourceNote: 2026 七月暑期檔片單過多、觀眾倍速追劇習慣觀察，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
暑假的片單長到你要用選的：
新劇一週上三部，
每部十六集。

所以你練出了一套追劇技能：
片頭跳過、
倍速一點二五、
配角講話的時候滑手機、
吵架戲直接拉進度條。

然後某一部劇，
你莫名其妙
把片頭整個看完了。

第二集，還是看完。
第八集，你開始跟著哼。

最後一集播完，
片尾跑完了你也沒關，
就讓它黑在那裡。

判斷一部劇有沒有真的打到你，
不用看評分，
看你有沒有捨得跳過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給暑假片單爆炸、每部都追到一半的朋友——會讓你乖乖看完片頭的那部，才是今年的本命
variations: 同理可證：判斷你是不是真的喜歡一個人，不是看你多想跟他說話，是看他講廢話的時候你有沒有拿起手機

en.content:
The summer lineup is so long
you have to triage:
three new shows a week,
sixteen episodes each.

So you developed a skill set —
skip the opening,
1.25x speed,
phone out whenever the side characters talk,
drag the bar through the arguing scenes.

Then one show comes along
and for no reason at all
you watch the whole opening.

Episode two, you watch it again.
Episode eight, you're humming along.

And when the finale ends,
you let the credits run all the way out
and just sit there in the black screen.

You don't need a rating
to know if a show got you.
You just need to notice
what you couldn't bring yourself to skip.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend with twelve half-finished shows this summer — the one whose opening you never skip is the real one
variations: Same logic applies to people: you can tell how much you like someone not by how badly you want to talk, but by whether you reach for your phone while they're rambling about nothing.

items.sourceNote: 韓劇下集預告手法與人生對照，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
每一集結束，
韓劇都會多給你三十秒：

下集預告。

讓你先看見他們會重逢、
會吵架、
會在某個轉角撞到彼此。

所以再難過的一集，
你都撐得下去，
因為你知道後面還有。

人生沒有這三十秒。

這集播完就是黑畫面，
沒有人告訴你
下一集誰會出現。

可是換個角度想——

如果你早就看過預告，
那些好的事情發生的時候，
你就不會
那麼用力地
心跳了一下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直想知道結局才敢往前走的人——看不到預告，才有真的驚喜
variations: 換個說法：你討厭的不是未知，是等待。可是所有你這輩子記得最清楚的畫面，當初都沒有預告過

en.content:
At the end of every episode,
K-dramas hand you thirty extra seconds:

the preview for the next one.

You get to see in advance
that they'll meet again,
that they'll fight,
that they'll collide at some corner.

So no matter how brutal the episode,
you make it through —
because you already know
there's more coming.

Life doesn't give you those thirty seconds.

This episode ends and the screen goes black.
Nobody tells you
who shows up in the next one.

But here's the other way to see it:

if you'd already watched the preview,
then when the good things finally happened,
your heart wouldn't have
jumped
quite that hard.
en.editorNote: Send to the person who won't move forward until they know how it ends — no preview is exactly what makes it a surprise
variations: Another way to put it: what you hate isn't the unknown, it's the waiting. But every moment you remember most clearly from your life came with no preview at all.

items.sourceNote: Perfect Crown『孤獨在人多的地方更大聲』意象，原創改編

zh-tw.content:
韓劇裡最寂寞的一幕，
從來不是主角一個人的時候。

是他站在滿滿的人裡面，
大家都在笑，
酒杯碰來碰去，
只有他
聽見自己心裡那一片安靜。

原來孤獨
不是沒有人，
是身邊全是人，
卻沒有一個
知道你今天過得好不好。

人越多的房間，
那種安靜
越大聲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在聚會裡笑得很大聲、回到家卻一句話都不想說的朋友——你不是不合群，你只是還沒遇到對的人
variations: 換句話說：真正的陪伴不是有人坐在你旁邊，是有人在你安靜下來的時候，也願意跟你一起安靜

en.content:
The loneliest shot in any K-drama
is never the lead standing alone.

It's the lead standing
in the middle of a packed room —
everyone laughing,
glasses clinking,
and only they can hear
how quiet it is inside.

Turns out loneliness
isn't the absence of people.
It's being surrounded by them
while not a single one
knows how your day actually went.

The more crowded the room,
the louder
that quiet gets.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who laughs the loudest at parties and goes silent the moment they get home — you're not bad at crowds, you just haven't found your person yet
